Package index

Setting up

Functions that set up and update a ‘many’ package.

setup_package()
Create a new package in the manydata universe
update_package()
Updates packages of our data universe
add_author()
Add an author to the current package
add_bib()
Add .bib file

Importing and exporting

Functions that bring data into a ‘many’ package and save it as a datacube.

import_data()
Imports and establishes preparation of raw data
export_data()
Adding datasets to the many packages universe
convert_pdf()
Get and convert PDFs to text

Functions that code identifiers for international agreements.

Code Abbreviations for Activity
code_agreements()
Code Agreement Titles
code_known_agreements()
Code Known Agreements Abbreviation
code_linkage()
Code Agreement Linkages
code_type()
Code Agreement Type
condense_agreements()
Condense similar treatyIDs

Functions that help with the development of R packages.

depends()
Loading packages
retain()
Keep objects from the global environment

Calling CRAN for the packages of an author
find_undocumented_values() find_nonascii()
Finding what CRAN asks to fix

Finding the sizes of the installed packages
find_transitive_minR() find_required_r()
Finding the minimum R version that a package needs
group_functions()

print_help()
Printing a help page to the console

Analyze Big-O algorithmic complexity of a network function
